ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a line chart of Jiangsu population growth from 2001 to 2007, including three lines: “total growth amount”, “natural growth amount”, and “mechanical growth amount”. Locating 2004 to 2006, it can be seen that the total population growth amount rose clearly; during the same period, the natural growth amount changed very little and basically remained stable; while the mechanical growth amount rose greatly, and was consistent with the rising trend of the total growth amount. Then reason: the acceleration of the total population growth rate was mainly synchronized with the increase in mechanical growth amount, rather than caused by changes in the natural growth amount. Mechanical growth mainly refers to population changes caused by population moving in and moving out, therefore the main reason why the population growth rate of Jiangsu Province clearly accelerated from 2004 to 2006 was that there were relatively many people from other provinces and regions moving into Jiangsu.
